segments.t: Director Valerie Donzelli drops by ASK with a surprise announcement: she wants Herve to play a lead role in her movie. After she leaves, Camille promises to keep Herve's new acting secret safe from Gabriel. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Hervé, j'ai une excellente nouvelle.
Vous avez choisi mon acteur Alex?
Non, j'ai choisi son grand frère.
Et ce frère, c'est vous, Hervé!
Vous seul pouvez jouer ce rôle.
Vous étiez vraiment remarquable au casting.
Moi? Je ne suis pas acteur!
Je ne savais pas ton talent.
Tu crois que tu diras oui?
Je ne peux rien dire à Gabriel.
Personne ne t'oblige à lui parler.
Je sais très bien garder les secrets.
C'est le début d'une aventure secrète!
Félicitations pour ton premier rôle, Hervé!
Let's examine Herve's surprise transition from assistant to actor line by line.
Hervé, j'ai une excellente nouvelle.
'Herve, I have excellent news.' Valerie opens the meeting with an exciting announcement.
Vous avez choisi mon acteur Alex?
'Did you choose my actor Alex?' Herve assumes his client secured the casting.
Non, j'ai choisi son grand frère.
'No, I chose his big brother.' Valerie clarifies that she picked a different character.
Et ce frère, c'est vous, Hervé!
'And that brother is you, Herve!' Valerie reveals her surprising casting decision.
Vous seul pouvez jouer ce rôle.
'Only you can play this role.' Valerie insists that Herve is unique for the part.
Vous étiez vraiment remarquable au casting.
'You were truly remarkable at the audition.' Valerie praises his natural screen presence.
Moi? Je ne suis pas acteur!
'Me? I am not an actor!' Herve gasps with shock at the unexpected proposition.
Je ne savais pas ton talent.
'I did not know your talent.' Camille smiles and compliments her fellow assistant.
Tu crois que tu diras oui?
'Do you think you will say yes?' Camille asks whether he plans to accept.
Je ne peux rien dire à Gabriel.
'I cannot say anything to Gabriel.' Herve fears his boss will disapprove.
Personne ne t'oblige à lui parler.
'Nobody is forcing you to tell him.' Camille reassures him that he has options.
Je sais très bien garder les secrets.
'I am very good at keeping secrets.' Camille offers her complete confidentiality.
C'est le début d'une aventure secrète!
'This is the start of a secret adventure!' Herve accepts the challenge with excitement.
Félicitations pour ton premier rôle, Hervé!
'Congratulations on your first role, Herve!' Camille celebrates his dramatic breakthrough. Now listen to the whole scene again at normal speed, and see how much more you catch.

Stunned by Valerie Donzelli's offer to cast him in her film, Herve worries about Gabriel's reaction, but Camille pledges total secrecy as Herve embarks on his secret acting debut. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'excellent' and 'piece of news'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
À demain!
